top_issues: Bottom ~40% of the canvas is empty on desktop; the Recent and Accounts panels stop mid-screen so the page reads unfinished.
Unit mismatch: the 'Instant' line says 'receive up to $250.75' while the H1 card says 'receive up to 0.50' with no currency and no reconciliation, which makes Maya doubt the number.
fixes: Dock Recent/Accounts to full column height or add a 'Needs attention' strip so the grid fills vertically.
Show every capacity with the same unit and a one-line derivation (sum of lanes) so 0.50 vs 250.75 is self-explaining.

top_issues: Fee rendered as '0.000050 USDC' — honest but unreadable to a first-timer and it sits at the same visual weight as 'Arrives Instantly'.
The 'Change' link floats next to 'Instant' delivery with no label, so it is unclear what it changes (route? speed?).
fixes: Show fee as '$0.00' with the precise value in a tooltip/subtext.
Relabel to 'Change route' and group Fee/Arrives/Delivery into one 'Summary' card so the action bar reads as a single decision.

top_issues: 'Settled 04:31:51 in 8 s' mixes a wall-clock time with a duration without separating them; the green 'in 8 s' reads like a countdown still running.
Proof hash is truncated to '0x59e3c301…e30e' with no copy affordance on the hash itself, only on the whole receipt.
fixes: Split into 'Settled 04:31:51 · took 8 s' with the duration in neutral gray.
Make the Proof row individually copyable and add a 'verify on chain' affordance for Kenji.

top_issues: Huge empty lower half; the QR + amount + account + note stack ends at ~70% height leaving the right column with only two small cards.
'25.50 capacity via H1' is shown as a hint but the relationship between capacity and the optional amount is never drawn, so a payer can over-request.
fixes: Enlarge the QR and pull the Share panel to full height; add a capacity bar under the amount field.
Render capacity as a live bar tied to the amount field so '0.00 / 25.50' is obvious.

top_issues: The collateral-tariff paragraph ('0.1 WETH base + 0 WETH gas + 1 bps…') is dense jargon placed between the quote and the CTA, exactly where Anya wants a clean net price.
Order-book bars are scaled to size but the price ladder uses 4 decimals and a comma thousands separator inconsistently against the 6-decimal receive field.
fixes: Collapse the tariff into one 'Estimated fee: 0.0000 WETH (1 bp)' line with the formula behind a 'details' disclosure.
Standardize decimal policy per asset (USDC 2, WETH 6) and right-align all numeric columns.

top_issues: Direct contradiction inside one screen: the USDC lane shows 'Collateral 60.00' (green) while 'THIS ACCOUNT' shows 'Covered by collateral $0.00' and Home shows 'Secured $0.00' — the same 60 is both secured and uncovered.
The lane legend lists 'in flight' but no value or marker on the bar is labeled in-flight, so the gray tail is ambiguous.
fixes: Make collateral/secured/covered derive from one lane record and show the same number in all three places, or label them as different concepts (posted vs applied vs uncovered).
Annotate the bar segments with their legend key on hover and show the in-flight amount explicitly.

top_issues: Timestamps like '04:31:43' carry no date; across a real ledger this is unreadable for Ravi's export.
The detail card always shows the selected 'Sent' entry but the list row and the card repeat the same proof/frame, wasting the right column's height.
fixes: Use 'Today 04:31:51' / absolute date beyond 24h, and include it in the CSV export.
Add a compact per-row sparkline or running-balance so the detail panel earns its space.

top_issues: Pixel-identical to 07-activity.png, so the 'detail' state demonstrates nothing new and the selected-row highlight is the only cue.
No way to open the full proof from the detail card (no 'view frames' / 'verify' action) despite it being the trust surface.
fixes: Make 08 actually show a different selection (e.g. an open Swap) so the panel proves it is reactive.
Add 'Open frames' and 'Copy proof' buttons to the detail card.

top_issues: The 'DESIGN / presets: yours to change' block (Material, Accent, Numbers, Risk color) is reviewer-facing meta that a normal user will not parse, and it sits above the security Vault controls.
Single narrow left column with a 1000px-tall empty right gutter except one small scale-preview card.
fixes: Move design presets under an 'Advanced / Appearance' disclosure and raise Vault/Security to the top.
Two-column the settings so the scale preview and runtime id fill the right rail.

top_issues: Move only crosses layers (Wallet/Reserve/Account); there is no network/chain selector, so Fatima's 'USDT from one chain to another through a hub' cannot be completed here even though the screen is named Move.
The FROM/TO cards print a balance ('Account 150.00 USD') that is actually a send capacity, conflating holdings with headroom.
fixes: Add a From-network / To-network control (mirroring Swap's 'Across networks') and show the on-chain fee for a cross-chain leg.
Label card numbers as 'available to move' vs 'balance' and never show a capacity as a balance.

top_issues: Very sparse: five tiles, one accounts card, one summary, one 'Needs attention' empty state, then ~45% of the page is blank.
'Where your money stands' duplicates the Home legend verbatim, so the same green/violet math is restated without adding a drill-down.
fixes: Give each tile a one-line live figure (e.g. Sovereignty 'Enforceable now $40') so the hub is scannable and fills the grid.
Make the summary rows clickable to the matching screen instead of repeating Home.

top_issues: The right 'FAUCETS' column stacks a token picker, an amount, a collateral slider, a credit-limit grant, a 10% buffer checkbox and four action buttons in one scroll — three different intents (test money, fund account, extend credit) fused into one panel.
Numbers like '81.949975 USDC' and '115.499973 → 197.449948 USDC' at full precision dominate a faucet screen meant to be trivial.
fixes: Split into 'Get test money', 'Fund an account', 'Adjust credit' as separate tabs; round displayed credit to 2 decimals with exact value on hover.
Remove the 'SUN'/'TRX' tokens unless the connected network actually serves them, or gate them behind the network.

top_issues: The pool is all zeros (Available/Borrowed/Active principal 0.00) so Anya cannot judge a fair rate, yet the form invites an offer with no market feedback.
Term chips (1 hour/1 day/1 month) and the '1.00% per term' conversion are good, but there is no APY normalization across terms.
fixes: Show pool utilization and a recent-rate sparkline even when empty (or a clear 'no pool yet' state).
Display annualized rate next to the per-term figure.

top_issues: Almost entirely empty below the board card; the one powerful idea (quorum 2-of-3, on-chain rotation) is described in prose with no interactive path to add signers.
'Take control of another entity' panel is a dead empty state occupying prime right-column space.
fixes: Add an inline 'Add signer / change threshold' action that opens a board editor (even if disabled, show the affordance).
Replace the empty takeover card with a board-preview diagram of current signers.

top_issues: The 'PER COUNTERPARTY' card text runs off the right edge ('…open → Manage → Dispute' is clipped), so the single most important action for Kenji is cut off.
Four stacked explanatory paragraphs (green/violet, 'Inside: 1 account…', 'Frame hashes…') dilute the headline number.
fixes: Constrain the counterparty card to the column width with a wrapping 'Open dispute' button instead of an inline arrow trail.
Promote 'Save evidence bundle' to a sticky primary action and demote the prose to a collapsible 'How this works'.

top_issues: The ledger table's last column 'LINES OUT·IN' is clipped by the order-book panel and the values ('115.50·0.00', '0.0·0.0') are truncated, defeating the dense-console purpose.
Large empty lower-left quadrant under the table; the console wastes the space it exists to fill.
Reserve row mixes '$40.00' (USD) with the lane rows' raw numbers, breaking column alignment.
fixes: Give the table a horizontal scroll or shrink the order book to a toggleable drawer so all columns are visible.
Extend the table with in-flight/pending rows or a totals footer to fill the vertical space.

top_issues: The palette lists destinations but offers no fuzzy match / recent / favorites, and the dimmed desk behind still shows the clipped table, so the overlay inherits 16's problem.
Descriptions ('dense console', 'batch, attention, doors') are cryptic to a first-timer scanning the list.
fixes: Add recent/favorites and a one-key shortcut hint per row; plain-language the descriptions.
Blur or simplify the background so the overlay reads as the focus.

overall.verdict: This is a coherent, premium, genuinely novel wallet UI whose single-absolute-scale bars and 'enforceable-now' framing are a real differentiator that a skeptical investor and a security maximalist can both read off the screens. It is held back by a few data contradictions (collateral vs secured/covered), horizontal clipping on the densest views (Desk, Sovereignty), wasted vertical space on desktop, and jargon density that blocks first-timers and cross-border senders on the Move/Assets paths.
priority_fixes: Resolve the collateral/secured/covered contradiction: one lane-derived number shown identically on Home, Account and Sovereignty (06 vs 01 vs 15).
Fix horizontal overflow: make the Desk table's 'LINES OUT·IN' column and the Sovereignty per-counterparty text fully visible (scroll, wrap, or drawer).
Give Move an explicit network/chain selector and a visible cross-chain fee so Fatima's task is completable from that screen.
De-jargon the novice path: human-readable fees ('$0.00'), one plain 'what you can spend' line on Home/Pay, and split the overloaded Assets/Faucet panel into three intents.
Use the empty desktop space (Home, Receive, Manage, Ownership, Desk) and de-duplicate 07/08 so each screen earns its canvas.

personas.name: Maya
personas.verdict: I can tap Pay and send 20, and the 'How to read this' box actually made the green/purple bar click — but getting money in and the '0.000050' fee made me nervous.
blockers: 12-assets: the faucet/credit panel is unreadable for funding my first balance

personas.name: Tomasz
personas.verdict: Credit line vs collateral is right there on the Account screen and I get the risk in well under 30s — except the same 60 collateral is shown as both secured and uncovered, which broke my trust in the numbers.

personas.name: Anya
personas.verdict: A live hub order book with tappable levels and a bilateral settlement line is exactly what I want; I just need the tariff collapsed and a real pool rate when I go to lend.
blockers: 05-swap: fee/tariff paragraph obscures the net quote
13-lend: empty pool gives no rate to judge

personas.name: Ravi
personas.verdict: I can see what is enforceable on-chain right now ($40), export a CSV, and pull a signed evidence bundle for the board — though the timestamps lack dates and the proof isn't individually verifiable from the receipt.
blockers: 07/08-activity: no date on timestamps for audit export
03-receipt: proof hash not copyable/verifiable on its own

personas.name: Sofia

blockers: 04-receive: no explicit 'invoice' framing or amount-in-link preview

personas.name: Kenji

personas.name: Lena
personas.verdict: I cannot judge my one-handed checkout task at all: this review set is desktop-dark only and contains no mobile screenshots.
blockers: No mobile variant attached to this set — task unverifiable

personas.name: Marcus
personas.verdict: Desk is the console I want and the Account screen gives exposure per lane, but the dense table clips its rightmost columns so I can't actually read lines-out/in at a glance.

personas.name: Fatima

personas.name: Dmitri
personas.verdict: In three minutes the one-scale bars plus 'enforceable now' vs 'promised' tell me exactly what is different and why it is safe; it looks like a private bank terminal, not another wallet.
